summary: The one vendored/minified-code rule, shared by find (drops it from the page and marks `vendor` on --json rows so file-inject never points at it) and the embedder (sketchFilter: vendor code is NEVER embedded — a standing USER rule). isVendorOrMinified = node_modules|vendor|bower_components path, *.min.js/css, or script/style files whose chars-per-line (tokenEstimate*4/lineCount) exceed 1000. isVendorForEmbedding adds third_party, site-packages, .venv/venv, Pods, Carthage, .yarn, jspm_packages, deps for the embedder only, so find's page behaviour (and benchmarks) did not change; external/extern were left out on purpose because some repos keep first-party code there.
